assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production 16:9 mahjong game title background, no UI. Input image is the composition and character identity reference. Repaint the entire reference as authentic early-1990s MS-DOS VGA adventure-game pixel art, with very visible large square pixel clusters, crisp stepped silhouettes, limited indexed colors, clean bold shading in 3-5 tones per material, navy shadows, saturated cyan/teal accents and warm gold highlights. Materially coarse and bright, NOT fine PC-98 pastel dithering. Think hand-drawn 320x180 pixel artwork enlarged with nearest-neighbor to 16:9. Preserve the exact camera, scene geography and object placements of the reference. Preserve the quiet very dark left 40% as low-detail negative space for later DOM text. Preserve the four characters occupying right 60%, identical faces, poses, clothing and relationships: Xiaocui green twin tails with pink bows and sailor outfit large at front right reaching her hand, Yuehua long silver hair seated at center-left, Aming black spiky hair red headband and orange jacket seated behind right, Lanjie purple updo and glasses standing center-back in red qipao holding tea tray. Keep faces expressive and readable using deliberate pixel clusters. Keep same green mahjong table below, amber pendant lamp upper right, window and warm wooden parlor. Tile details become tiny abstract colored pixel marks, never legible words. Full bleed landscape 16:9, preferably 1672x940 matching reference. No extra people, no modern painterly brushwork, no smooth gradients, no blur, no photographic textures, no CRT/bezel, no interface, no logo, no titles, no legible text, no borders. This must be an actual pixel-art redraw, not merely a palette filter.
